content.value: During the summer break of my third undergraduate year, I interned on SensingChange at York University, an interdisciplinary research-creation project on black carbon air pollution and critical artworks. The initiative merges art, science, and engineering to make invisible pollution visible through wearable sensors, illuminated garments, and public installations that respond to local air quality.
, I designed the visual identity and digital presence: logo, colour system, and the website launched during my internship.
remains the public hub. The placement was credited toward my degree under Professor
, whose critique sharpened the identity and site.
